scriptData.label: @effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
The arrow rips the brachial artery, the major blood vessel running along the inside of your upper arm, causing a spurting crimson deluge. Within seconds the whole side of your body is drenched in blood!

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (3).

Extraction will be Challenging (+0) and any failure will result in gaining one @Condition[Bleeding] Condition as the arrow tears the artery up even further.
